title: Reorder List
description:
You are given the `head` of a singly linked list `L0 -> L1 -> ... -> Ln-1 -> Ln`. Reorder it **in place** into `L0 -> Ln -> L1 -> Ln-1 -> L2 -> Ln-2 -> ...`

You may not change the values inside the nodes; only the nodes themselves may be rearranged. The function returns nothing: the test checks the list that `head` points to after your function runs.
hints: Find the middle with slow/fast pointers.
Reverse the second half, then weave the two halves together one node at a time.
